corrections.reason: The printed Ge'ez vocative particle 'ኦ' before 'ሊቅ' ('ኦሊቅ ሙሴ') is clearly visible in the image and was omitted in Draft Pass 1.
Both the printed glyph and Classical Ge'ez syntax ('እንዘ አልቦ ውሉድ', matching line 25) have 6th-order 'ድ' ('ውሉድ'), not 'ደ'.
The printed character is 6th-order 'ህ' in 'እንደዚህም', misread as 1st-order 'ሀ'.
Both the printed glyph at the end of the line and canonical Ge'ez morphology ('በኢያእምሮ መጻሕፍት', Mt 22:29) have 4th-order 'ያ', not 6th-order 'ይ'.
